# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and prospective teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive young woman with fair skin, long blonde hair, and big, vivid blue eyes. She has a radiant, striking complexion and a full, eye-catching shape. In town, she wears her hair styled up and wears her skirts as long as her mother permits, though she wears her hair down when returning home.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Opal possesses a sunny, pleasant disposition and delights openly in the enjoyable aspects of living. She laughs often and is deeply focused on romance, suitors, and young men. However, she is easily frightened and prone to fits of hysterics during stressful or dramatic situations.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

- creative story writing  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- to get a boyfriend upon turning fifteen and get married after teaching for two years  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley school, where she frequently shared gossip about her older sisters and courting, participated in recitations, and joined the local girls' story-writing club. She took part in school events and games, including portraying King Arthur in a dramatic reenactment of Elaine on the river. Later, she enrolled in the Regent's entrance class alongside her classmates, successfully passed the Entrance exams after an anxious period of testing, and attended Regent's Academy in Port Marlow. Upon completing her course at the Academy and passing her examinations, she secured a position to teach in a western location.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c21 P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
